schedules.bridgeFeaturesInfo.description:
<emph>Repeat function</emph>

Select the specific days you want this routine to run. No more manually setting it every day!

<emph>Room selection</emph>

Choose more lights, Zones, or even entire Rooms to participate in the automation and enhance your bedtime routine.

<emph>More personalization</emph>

Choose whether lights should turn off completely, or end at a low brightness level so that it’s never pitch black.

If you have switches, you can trigger your Go to sleep routine by simply pressing the button.

<emph>Room selection</emph>

Choose more lights, Zones, or even entire Rooms to participate in the automation and enhance your experience.

<emph>Scene selection</emph>

Instead of a single color, you can now select a Scene that you want to be activated when the timer runs out.

<emph>Use devices</emph>

This automation can be started or stopped by the press of a button if you have smart devices in your system.

<emph>Repeat function</emph>

Select the specific days you want this routine to run. No more manually setting it every day!

<emph>Room selection</emph>

Choose more lights, Zones, or even entire Rooms to participate in the routine and enhance your wake-up experience.

<emph>More personalization</emph>

Lights too bright? You can choose the maximum brightness at which the automation will stop. You can also decide whether the lights should turn off after the routine ends.

schedules.creationFlow.chooseType.coming:
Never arrive in the dark again. With a Hue Bridge, your lights can <emph>turn on automatically when you near your house</emph>. It even works with multiple users.

And if you don't want to waste energy, you can set it to only activate between sunset and sunrise.
Set your lights to turn on automatically when you near your house.
schedules.creationFlow.chooseType.custom:
Do it your way. With a Hue Bridge, you can create custom automations to <emph>schedule when certain lights should turn on or off</emph>, like setting garden lights to turn on in the evening, or desk lights turn off at the end of the work day.

You can choose fixed days and times, or have it sync with your local sunrise and sunset times so that you don't need to adjust the time throughout the year.
schedules.creationFlow.chooseType.goToSl: Slowly dim a light to help you fall asleep easier
schedules.creationFlow.chooseType.leavin:
Did you leave the lights on? No worries. With a Hue Bridge, your lights can be set to <emph>turn off automatically when you leave your house</emph>. Perfect to use alongside the Coming home feature.

Others at home? As long as there's one phone still at home, we won't leave them in the dark.
Set your lights to turn off automatically when you leave your house.
schedules.creationFlow.chooseType.mimicP:
Anyone home? It'll sure look like it. With a Hue Bridge, you can <emph>make it seem like there's someone home</emph> even when the house is empty. This feature automatically and semi-randomly turns lights on and off depending on the type of room selected so that from the outside it looks inhabited.

You can even set it to only work when it's dark out so you don't waste energy.
Set your lights to turn on and off to make it look like you're home.
Use a light to signal the end of a timer
